The hiring company is a multinational organization with a long-standing presence in the global market.

Jobomschrijving

• Oversee day-to-day IT operations, ensuring reliable infrastructure and support services.

Our client is an innovative SME located in the Maldegem region, specialising in the design, development and installation of high-tech test and measurement equipment for the agricultural sector. Their tailor-made solutions are used worldwide by machine manufacturers, universities and testing centres to accurately test, measure and optimise agricultural machinery. By combining engineering, machine building and automation, they deliver customised projects for customers across the globe.

Jobomschrijving

As a Project Engineer Machine Building, you will be involved in the complete development of innovative machines and testing systems. From the initial concept to the final installation at the customer's site, you will play an active role throughout the entire project lifecycle. This is a varied position combining engineering, assembly, testing and international commissioning.

As a Project Engineer Machine Building, your responsibilities include:

• Developing and improving new machines and technical solutions.
• Building, assembling and testing prototypes.
• Installing, commissioning and fine-tuning equipment at customer sites both nationally and internationally.
• Analysing technical issues and proposing improvements to products and processes.
• Preparing technical documentation, manuals and work instructions.
• Collaborating closely with colleagues from engineering, production and service departments.
• Providing technical support during demonstrations, trade fairs and commercial activities.

For this positFor this position as Project Engineer Machine Building, we are looking for an all-round engineer who enjoys combining theory with hands-on technical work. You like taking ownership of projects from start to finish and are willing to travel internationally on a regular basis.

As a Project Engineer Machine Building, you have:

• A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electromechanics, Mechanical Engineering, Product Development, Machine Building or a related technical field.
• A strong interest in machine building, automation and product development.
• A hands-on mentality and practical approach to engineering.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Willingness to travel internationally for installations and commissioning projects.
• A good command of English.
• Knowledge of Dutch is mandatory.
• A valid Category B driving licence.

Your responsibilities as a Senior Treasury Analyst :

• Manage liquidity, cash flow planning and day-to-day treasury operations across multiple entities.
• Oversee international banking relationships, cross-border payments and multi-currency activities.
• Develop and improve treasury processes, policies and internal controls.
• Work with Treasury Management Systems.
• Support treasury transformation through automation, system improvements and process standardisation.
• Analyse and optimise treasury data.
• Collaborate with Finance and other stakeholders across an international organisation.
• Contribute to treasury activities in a rapidly evolving, high-growth environment.
 

 

About the candidate :

• You have minimum 5 years of experience in corporate treasury or cash management within an international, multi-entity environment.
• You bring strong expertise in liquidity management, treasury operations and international banking.
• You have hands-on experience with a Treasury Management System.
• You have experience improving treasury processes, policies and control frameworks.
• You bring a proactive, structured and accountable approach, with the ability to work independently.
• You are a strong team player who communicates effectively across different functions and stakeholders.
• You are comfortable working in a fast-changing and sometimes ambiguous environment.
• You speak fluent English; no other languages are required.

Our client is a well-established international player in the fashion industry, renowned for its creativity, quality, and commitment to excellence. Based in Brussels, the company offers a dynamic and fast-paced working environment where innovation, collaboration, and passion for fashion drive success.

Jobomschrijving

As a Personal Assistant your responsibilities are:

• Manage and organize daily schedules, appointments, and meetings of the CEO, both professional and personal.
• Prepare and handle confidential documentation.
• Be a first point of contact for the CEO, answer calls and emails.
• Coordinate travel arrangements, including flights, accommodations, and itineraries.
• Act as a point of contact between internal teams and external stakeholders.
• Maintain an organized filing system for important documents and records.

A successful Personal Assistant should have:

• Proven experience in administrative roles (3  years preferred, with a minimum of 2).
• Strong organizational and multitasking abilities.
• Proficiency in using office software and tools.
• Excellent communication skills in English and preferably French or Dutch.
• A proactive and detail-oriented approach to work.

Company Description

Our client is an international company operating in the real estate sector, located in the heart of Brussels. With a multicultural environment and several entities to manage, the company operates within an international structure and works closely with its parent company abroad. The finance team deals with multiple accounting standards and international reporting requirements.

Your Role

Working directly alongside the Chief Accountant, you will be responsible for the accounting of several entities and contribute to the preparation of financial information for both local and international reporting purposes. You will work with Belgian GAAP and US GAAP, while also contributing to IFRS reporting.

Your Responsibilities

• Manage the general accounting of several entities.
• Ensure compliance with Belgian GAAP and US GAAP, depending on the entity.
• Participate in monthly and annual closing procedures.
• Prepare the necessary adjustments for IFRS reporting.
• Perform account reconciliations and ensure the accuracy of financial data.
• Contribute to reporting activities for the parent company.
• Work closely with the Chief Accountant and support the continuous improvement of accounting processes and internal controls.
• Collaborate with international finance teams to ensure consistent and reliable financial information.

Your Profile

• You have a degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field.
• You have solid experience in general accounting.
• You are familiar with Belgian GAAP and are willing to develop your knowledge of US GAAP and IFRS.
• You are comfortable working with Excel and accounting software.
• You are rigorous, analytical and detail-oriented.
• A good command of English is an asset in this international environment.

Responsibilities

• Manage virtual teams across different departments to ensure continuous alignment between various stakeholders.
• Deliver business and technical projects on-time, on-scope, and on-budget using established project methodologies.
• Define project budgets, manage approvals through governance bodies, and monitor variances to prevent cost overruns.
• Develop realistic project plans and secure commitments from various departments regarding expected results.
• Identify risks pro-actively and initiate appropriate actions or escalations to mitigate potential issues.
• Provide continuous reporting on project status to management and offer day-to-day coaching to team members.

Requirements

• You have 5+ years of experience as a dedicated Project Manager within complex, large-scale environments.
• You bring a proven track record in managing end-to-end business and technical projects involving IT development.
• You possess proficiency in project management methodologies including PMI, Prince 2, and Agile.
• You have experience using office and planning tools such as MS Project, Excel, Powerpoint, and Word.
• You're an autonomous and result-driven professional with strong leadership and conflict management skills.
• You are fluent in Dutch, French, and English.
Nice to Haves

• Experience with MS-Access.
• Ability to maintain composure and effectiveness in a continuously changing environment.

• Our client is an established property developer expanding its residential portfolio in Luxembourg, with a focus on well-designed, energy-efficient homes.
• Its local team combines an entrepreneurial working environment with the expertise and resources of a wider development group.
• Working closely with local management, you will have direct involvement in sales activity and the opportunity to contribute ideas that support commercial growth.

Jobomschrijving

• Drive sales across a portfolio of residential developments, advising both owner-occupiers and property investors.
• Understand buyers' priorities, budgets and investment objectives to recommend suitable properties.
• Convert enquiries into qualified opportunities through proactive prospecting, consistent follow-up and personalised advice.
• Lead property viewings, project presentations and sales meetings, guiding clients through the purchasing process.
• Build referral relationships with local agents, notaries, investors and other property professionals.
• Coordinate with marketing on lead generation, campaigns and events to support sales conversion.
• Monitor market trends, buyer demand and competing developments to identify commercial opportunities.
• Maintain accurate sales forecasts, pipeline records and performance reporting.
• Depending on your experience and interests, contribute to partnerships and the identification of potential development acquisitions.

• At least three years of relevant real estate sales experience, preferably involving new-build residential property.
• A sound understanding of the Luxembourg property market; an existing local network would be an advantage.
• Excellent French and professional working proficiency in English. Luxembourgish, German or Dutch would be an asset.
• The ability to tailor your advice to both lifestyle-driven buyers and investment-focused clients.
• A proactive approach to prospecting, supported by commercial drive and disciplined follow-through.
• Professional communication, discretion and the ability to build trust throughout a significant purchasing decision.
• Confidence working independently while collaborating closely with management and marketing.
• An interest in developing your contribution beyond individual property transactions.

Our client is a large Belgian organization with an extensive and business-critical IT environment. Within the infrastructure department, work is being done on various strategic programs concerning hybrid cloud, middleware, integration platforms, networking, and cybersecurity.To further structure multiple infrastructure projects and interdependencies, they are seeking an experienced IT Infrastructure Project Manager who takes ownership of planning, stakeholders, and delivery within the domains of AppStack, Network Security, and Networking.
Jobomschrijving
Here, you assume end-to-end management of multiple complex infrastructure projects within a hybrid enterprise environment.You coordinate projects related to middleware, integration, automation, networking, and network security, ensuring that technical teams and vendors remain aligned. You translate the various project lines into concrete plans, milestones, and deliverables, and closely monitor these using tools including MS Project and Jira.You guide technical teams during implementations, migrations, and infrastructure changes, while monitoring schedules, scope, budget, resources, risks, and dependencies.You organize alignment and synchronization meetings, maintain coherence between different initiatives, and ensure transparent communication with stakeholders and management.Additionally, you oversee governance, documentation, compliance, and security requirements.

•  5y experience as Project Manager in IT-infra
• You are strong in stakeholder management and diplomacy

Our client is a leading player within the commercial real estate sector in Belgium. Active on high-profile projects across Brussels and other major cities, our client supports businesses, investors, and property owners with innovative real estate solutions and strategic advisory services.

Jobomschrijving

As an Account Manager - Real Estate, your responsibilities will include:

• Managing and developing a portfolio of existing clients within the real estate sector.
• Identifying and pursuing new business opportunities through networking, prospecting, and market engagement.
• Advising clients on tailored real estate solutions aligned with their business and investment objectives.
• Leading commercial discussions, preparing proposals, and negotiating contracts.
• Collaborating closely with internal stakeholders to ensure exceptional service delivery and long-term client satisfaction.

The successful Account Manager - Real Estate should have:

• 2 to 5 years of experience in Account Management, Business Development, Sales, or a related commercial role.
• Strong relationship-building skills and the ability to engage with senior-level decision-makers.
• A proactive commercial mindset with a passion for developing business opportunities.
• Fluency in French and Dutch; English is considered a strong asset.
• Excellent communication, negotiation, and organisational skills.

You will work as part of a team on the further development and optimization of applications using a modern version of .NET & Angular, with a strong focus on performance, testing, and clean code. You ensure stable communication between various internal systems.Beyond your operational involvement, you will also have input into the broader technical direction. Within the team, you will have the opportunity to initiate technical improvements and actively contribute to building a robust and future-proof IT environment.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT (or equivalent through strong experience)
• Senior professional experience with .NET
• At least a first hands-on experience with Angular
• You're a pragmatic team player
• You work in English and understand Dutch & French

What will be your responsibilities?
 
 
 
• Facilitate the incorporation of new clients and commencement of matters. 
 
• Aid in the arrangement and subsequent follow-up of invoicing procedures. 
 
• Supervise the adherence to Know Your Client (KYC) identification protocols. 
 
• Track and ensure compliance with Bar points. 
 
• Handle document archiving, uphold database accuracy, and manage printing responsibilities. 
 
• Deliver comprehensive administrative assistance, encompassing the creation of PowerPoint presentations, coordinating travel logistics, and overseeing timesheet management. 
 
• Effectively organize schedules, arrange appointments with clients and colleagues, and manage logistics for recruitment interviews. 
 
• Serve as a substitute for other administrative assistants when necessary. 

can you recognise yourself in this?
 
 
 
• Demonstrate a proficient command of English and possess a solid passive understanding of either Dutch or French. 
 
• Hold a high school diploma, a bachelor's degree (although not obligatory), or can present equivalent work experience. 
 
• Exhibit a comprehensive understanding of MS Office applications (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint). 
 
• Display an inclination for financial and billing systems, expressing a genuine enjoyment of numerical work. 
 
• Showcase robust organizational skills, characterized by a high degree of structure and the ability to effectively prioritize tasks. 
 
• Set yourself apart through precision, accuracy, and a commitment to thoroughness in your work. 
 
• Proactively approach tasks with a customer-centric and service-oriented mindset. 
 
• Flourish in a collaborative team-oriented environment.

Michael Page is a globally recognised recruitment consultancy specialising in the placement of qualified professionals and managers across a wide range of sectors, including Finance, Human Resources, Sales & Marketing, Engineering, Supply Chain, Digital & Technology, Legal, and more.As part of our continued growth in Belgium, we are looking for ambitious and driven individuals to join our Brussels office and contribute to our success while building their own professional career.

Jobomschrijving

Business Development & Sales

• Identify and prospect new business opportunities within your market.
• Develop and manage a portfolio of clients across different industries.
• Conduct client meetings to understand hiring needs and business challenges.
• Negotiate commercial agreements and recruitment partnerships.
• Build long-term relationships with key decision-makers and HR stakeholders.
• Become a trusted advisor for your clients regarding talent acquisition and market trends.
Recruitment & Talent Acquisition

• Manage the full recruitment lifecycle from briefing to placement.
• Source and engage top talent through LinkedIn, job boards, networking, and referrals.
• Conduct interviews and assess candidates' skills, experience, and motivations.
• Present qualified candidates to clients and manage the interview process.
• Deliver an exceptional candidate experience throughout the recruitment journey.
• Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline within your specialisation.
Client Relationship Management

• Act as the main point of contact for your clients.
• Provide market insights and salary benchmarking.
• Ensure a high level of service and client satisfaction.
• Develop long-term partnerships based on trust and expertise.

• Previous experience in sales, business development, recruitment, consulting, customer service, or a commercial role.
• Strong interest in business development and client relationship management.
• Entrepreneurial mindset and passion for achieving results.
• Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
• Resilient, ambitious, and motivated by targets and performance.
• Ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
• Fluent in French and English or Dutch and English.
• Fluency in French, Dutch, and English is considered a significant advantage.

Joining our organization means becoming part of an international and dynamic retail environment.

Jobomschrijving

 People Strategy Develop and implement a comprehensive People & Culture strategy covering talent acquisition, talent development, succession planning, retention, and engagement.Talent Acquisition & Employer Branding Partner with recruitment teams to anticipate workforce needs, strengthen employer branding initiatives, and ensure an outstanding candidate experience.Culture & Employee Engagement Promote a strong organizational culture and implement initiatives that enhance employee engagement, well-being, and overall workplace experience.Learning & Development Drive learning strategies, identify development opportunities, and support employees and managers in achieving their full potential.Change Management & Communication Support organizational transformation projects, facilitate effective communication, and ensure alignment between business priorities and people initiatives.People Leadership Lead, coach, and develop the People team, fostering collaboration, accountability, empowerment, and high performance.People Analytics & Performance Track HR metrics and KPIs, analyze trends, and recommend data-driven actions that improve business performance and employee experience.

 You bring:

• Significant experience in Talent Management, Learning & Development, Organizational Development, or a strategic HR leadership role.
• Proven experience leading and developing teams.
• Experience within the retail or consumer-facing sector is an advantage.
• Strong communication, coaching, and stakeholder management skills.
• The ability to build trust and influence across all levels of an organization.
• Excellent organizational and analytical abilities, with a solution-oriented mindset.
• Adaptability and agility in fast-changing environments.
• Strong resilience and sound decision-making capabilities.
• A highly professional and people-centered approach, with a strong commitment to confidentiality.
• Fluency in at least two of the following languages: French, Dutch, and English.

As a 
field service engineer, you'll be the technical expert customers rely on to keep their industrial equipment running smoothly.
 

You'll work both 
on-site at customer facilities across the EMEA region and 
at the technical service center in Merchtem, combining hands-on troubleshooting, maintenance, and repairs with direct customer support.
 

Your responsibilities will include:
 
 

• Technical troubleshooting: Diagnose, analyze, and resolve issues with industrial measurement equipment, electronic systems, and process control technologies. 

• Installation & commissioning: Install, configure, and commission advanced technical equipment at customer sites throughout the EMEA region. 

• Maintenance & repairs: Perform technical repairs, preventive maintenance, and failure analysis, both on-site and at the workshop in Merchtem. 

• Customer support: Provide professional technical assistance, both remotely and in person, ensuring customers receive efficient and reliable solutions. 

• Technical training: Guide customers in the correct use, maintenance, and operation of their equipment. 

• Continuous improvement: Collaborate with international engineering and technical teams to identify recurring issues and contribute to product and service improvements. 

• Reporting & follow-up: Document technical interventions, maintain accurate service records, and take ownership of your assigned cases from start to finish.  

You'll spend approximately 
40–50% of your time travelling internationally, while the remaining time will mainly be dedicated to technical repairs, diagnostics, and support activities at the Merchtem service center.

What makes you a great match?
 
 

• You are 
fluent in Dutch, French, English, and German, allowing you to communicate confidently with customers and colleagues across the EMEA region. 

• You have a solid understanding of 
electrical systems, industrial electronics, and wiring. 

• You have hands-on experience in 
troubleshooting and repairing industrial electronics or control systems. 

• Ideally, you have at least 
2 years of experience in field service, industrial maintenance, or a manufacturing environment. 

• Experience with 
measurement equipment, process control systems, or industrial communication protocols (Modbus, EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, and PROFIBUS) is a strong advantage. 

• You're 
independent, proactive, and reliable, taking full ownership of your tasks and following through on your commitments. 

• You're 
customer-oriented and communicative, keeping customers and colleagues informed throughout the process. 

• You're comfortable working with 
targets, KPIs, and service deadlines while maintaining high-quality standards. 

• You're flexible and enthusiastic about 
international travel (approximately 50%), including overnight stays across the EMEA region. 

• You hold a 
valid driver's license and have a clean driving record.

jobs.occupation: Lawyer (FR or NL)  - Employment Law - Brussels
jobs.description:
Our client is a leading independent Belgian full-service law firm based in Brussels, advising both national and international companies across a broad range of legal matters, transactions, and disputes.

Jobomschrijving

• Advise Belgian and international clients on individual and collective employment law matters.
• Handle complex employment-related projects, including:
• Collective dismissals
• Employment regulations and policies
• Cross-border employment issues
• Service agreements
• Employment litigation
• Social law implications of restructurings, insolvencies, and corporate transactions
• Support clients involved in mergers and acquisitions from an employment law perspective.
• Draft, review, and negotiate employment-related documentation.
• Work closely with senior lawyers, Counsel, and partners while progressively taking ownership of files.
• Provide pragmatic, business-oriented legal advice to clients across multiple sectors.

• Qualified Belgian lawyer.
• Minimum 4 years of experience in Employment/Labour Law, ideally gained in a recognized law firm.
• Strong command of Dutch, with professional fluency in French and English.
• Excellent drafting and analytical skills.
• Pragmatic, solution-driven, and client-focused mindset.
• Autonomous, confident, and able to express ideas proactively.
• Entrepreneurial attitude demonstrated through professional, academic, or extracurricular initiatives.
• International exposure or an additional relevant master's degree is considered a plus.
• Team player who thrives in a collaborative and non-competitive culture.

As a robotic engineer, you will be part of our driven engineering team, where you will work together to develop high-quality software solutions. Your tasks will include:

• Develop, maintain, and improve robotic software using ROS2
• Integrate and optimize navigation stacks, SLAM, and sensor fusion
• Build perception systems using Computer Vision (e.g., object detection, visual localization)
• Design and deploy Machine Learning models for robotic perception and autonomous decision-making
• Work hands-on with real robots: system integration, deployment, tuning, and performance optimization
• Contribute to robot control, localization, and path planning
• Participate in on-site testing and customer deployments across Belgium and the Netherlands

• You are hands-on and have at least 3 to 5 years of experience and strong affinity with autonomous navigation, robotics, machine control or industrial automation
• You have a thorough knowledge of ROS2, C, C  , and Python
• Solid knowledge in majority of the following fields:Sensor fusion for state estimation and localization
• Control systems for robotics
• Path planning & Navigation (SLAM)
• Computer Vision and Machine Learning applied to robotics
• You are comfortable working with hardware and in real-world field environments and experience bringing systems from prototype to reliable field deployment
• You are able to work independently and take responsibility for your work
• You have a valid EU driving license (for site testing and deployments)
• You can communicate fluently in English

Our client is a well-established retail organization operating a large network of specialized stores across Belgium. With a strong focus on customer service and operational excellence, the company relies on robust IT solutions to support its stores and central services. To support ongoing growth and digital transformation initiatives, our client is looking for an IT Onsite Support to strengthen its IT team.

Jobomschrijving

As an IT Onsite Support, you will play a key role in supporting both store operations and corporate services. Acting as a first point of contact for IT-related issues, you will help ensure the smooth functioning of business-critical systems while contributing to continuous improvement initiatives:

• Provide 1st and 2nd line IT support to stores and central services, primarily remotely and occasionally on-site.
• Monitor the performance and availability of Point-of-Sale (POS) systems and coordinate issue resolution with internal or external stakeholders.
• Ensure accurate ticket logging, tracking, and follow-up through the company's service desk platform.
• Contribute to the maintenance and enhancement of POS and ERP-related functionalities.
• Create, update, and maintain user documentation and operational procedures.
• Participate in the development and enrichment of the internal knowledge base.
• Identify potential risks, recurring issues, and opportunities for process improvement.
• Support testing activities and system enhancements as your expertise develops.

• Strong motivation to learn and develop expertise in business applications and IT systems.
• Hands-on, proactive mindset with a customer-focused approach.
• Ability to work collaboratively while taking ownership of assigned tasks.
• Open to feedback and continuous improvement.
• Experience with Microsoft Dynamics NAV / Business Central is mandatory.
• Experience within a retail environment is a plus.
• Fluent in Dutch. French & English are an advantage.
• Willing to participate in an on-call rotation system (with appropriate compensation).
• Eager to learn and grow within a dynamic team environment.

Our client, an international company operating in the manufacturing sector, is looking for a Customer Service Representative to join its customer-facing team.

Jobomschrijving

In this role, you will be responsible for managing customer orders from A to Z, ensuring an excellent customer experience, and acting as the key point of contact between customers and internal departments. You will work closely with Sales, Supply Chain, Logistics, and Production teams to guarantee smooth order processing and timely deliveries.Key Responsibilities

• Manage customer orders throughout the entire order-to-cash process.
• Enter and follow up on orders in the ERP system.
• Serve as the primary contact for customer enquiries regarding orders, deliveries, and product availability.
• Coordinate with internal stakeholders to ensure efficient order fulfillment.
• Monitor delivery schedules and proactively communicate any changes or delays.
• Resolve customer issues and identify appropriate solutions.
• Maintain accurate customer records and administrative documentation.
• Support continuous improvement initiatives related to customer service processes.
• Build and maintain strong long-term customer relationships.

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent through experience.
• Previous experience in Customer Service, Order Management, Sales Support, or a similar administrative position.
• Strong communication skills and customer-oriented mindset.
• Fluent in Dutch and English. French is considered an asset.
• Experience working with ERP systems (SAP knowledge is a plus).
• Good command of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
Personal Skills

• Proactive and solution-oriented.
• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
• Able to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Team player with a collaborative mindset.
• Resilient and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
• Customer-focused with excellent relationship-building skills.

For an international organization within the medical sector based in Ghent, we are looking for an experienced Accountant to support the financial management of the Belgian operations. In this varied role, you will take broad responsibility for a range of financial and accounting processes.

Your responsibilities:

• You will manage the full accounting cycle (A to Z) for the Belgian entity and its related holding structure.
• You will be responsible for both general and analytical accounting, ensuring the accuracy and quality of financial data.
• You will act as the main point of contact for accounting and financial matters within the organization.
• You will handle monthly and annual closings and ensure accurate and timely financial reporting.
• You will prepare annual accounts and various statutory and tax filings, including VAT, Intrastat and statistical reporting.
• You will monitor outstanding receivables and payables and process payments and payroll-related accounting entries.
• You will work closely with external partners and advisors on tax matters, subsidies and other financial topics.
• You will support the annual audit process and act as a key contact during financial audits.
• You will contribute to budgeting, forecasting and variance analysis, helping to identify and explain deviations from financial targets.
• You will perform balance sheet reconciliations and controls, ensuring that discrepancies are identified and followed up appropriately.
• You will actively contribute to the improvement and optimization of financial processes, systems and procedures, working closely with the corporate finance team.

About you:

• You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or a related field.
• You have at least 10 years of relevant experience in accounting.
• You have a strong knowledge of general and analytical accounting.
• Experience in an international or corporate environment is considered an advantage.
• You have an excellent command of Dutch and English, both written and spoken.
• You have strong analytical skills and a keen eye for detail.
• You are independent, proactive and solution-oriented, while also being a strong team player.
• You are able to set priorities and maintain a high level of accuracy, even when working under tight deadlines.
• You are IT-minded and comfortable working with ERP systems and Excel.
